personal.name: Ahusan Mohamed

personal.bio: I build and run production software from Malé: banking systems, news platforms, resort reservations and the infrastructure underneath them.

projects.name: Gym Log - Personal Fitness Tracker PWA
projects.summary: An installable PWA that tracks gym streaks with a never-miss-twice rule.

caseStudy.challenge: One missed gym day kept turning into a missed week. I wanted a tool built around a single rule: never miss two days in a row.
approach: Tracked sessions, the current streak and a weekly goal of five sessions, with a 28-day calendar for history.
Built the two-day rule into the interface: a warning appears before a second missed day, and protected rest days don't break the streak.
Shipped it as an installable PWA with offline support, so logging a session takes seconds on a phone.
Hosted it in Docker on my own home server, so it costs nothing to run.
caseStudy.outcome: Live at gym.ahusan.dev and installable on any phone.

projects.name: Homelab Infrastructure & Automation
projects.summary: A Proxmox and Docker cluster at home running my own services around the clock, deployed through CI/CD.

caseStudy.challenge: I wanted a place to run my own services and try new infrastructure tools without paying cloud bills or risking anything in production.
approach: Virtualised the hardware with Proxmox so each service runs in its own isolated environment.
Containerised everything with Docker Compose behind an Nginx reverse proxy for secure outside access.
Added an Asustor NAS for central storage, with automated backups and a disaster-recovery routine.
Set up GitHub Actions pipelines for automated builds and deployments, plus my own maintenance and monitoring scripts.
caseStudy.outcome: It runs around the clock at 99.9% uptime with no recurring cloud costs, and hosts my own apps, including Gym Log. The CI/CD pipeline cut deployment time by 90% and removed manual steps, and the lab is my testing ground for new technology.

projects.name: Farudhun News Portal
projects.summary: Cut hosting costs by 80% for a national Dhivehi news site without giving up speed or uptime.

caseStudy.challenge: Farudhun is a Dhivehi-language news site read across the Maldives every day. Hosting cost about $100 a month, and any saving couldn't come at the cost of speed or uptime.
approach: Moved images and video to S3 storage with CDN delivery, taking media load off the web servers.
Added caching and tuned the MySQL database so each page takes less work to serve.
Reworked the hosting on DigitalOcean while keeping a high-availability setup.
Kept shipping features alongside: section organisation, correct right-to-left Dhivehi rendering and local SEO.
caseStudy.outcome: Monthly hosting fell from $100 to $20, an 80% cut, with no loss of performance or availability.

projects.name: CleanInstall Node
projects.summary: An npm CLI that clears node_modules, lock files and build output across monorepos.

caseStudy.challenge: Across many Node projects and monorepos, stale node_modules, lock files and build output eat disk space, and clearing them by hand is slow and error-prone.
approach: Built a CLI that understands npm, yarn and pnpm workspaces and finds every node_modules, lock file and build folder.
Added glob patterns for custom rules, plus dry-run and interactive modes so nothing is deleted by surprise.
Made it detect the package manager and reinstall dependencies afterwards, on any operating system.
Published it to npm under the MIT licence with a CI/CD release pipeline.
caseStudy.outcome: Available on npm and GitHub, with 34+ downloads a month.

projects.name: Allied Workflow Platform
projects.summary: A configurable workflow platform that plugs into Allied's portals and operations.

caseStudy.challenge: Allied needed a configurable workflow system that plugs into its existing portals and operational systems, instead of hard-coding each process.
approach: Designing it as microservices, so workflows and integrations can grow and change independently.
Building the services in NestJS and the interface in React with DaisyUI.

projects.name: SME Digital Rebranded Website
projects.summary: A from-scratch rebrand site on Next.js and Strapi for SME Digital.

caseStudy.challenge: SDFC was rebranding as SME Digital and needed a website that matched the new brand and was easier for the team to keep up to date.
approach: Rebuilt the site in Next.js with HeroUI components styled to the new brand.
Moved content into Strapi so the team can edit pages without a developer.
caseStudy.outcome: A faster site that's easier to manage, delivered before I moved on.

projects.name: SSR Reservation System
projects.summary: Availability, bookings and pricing for Sun Siyam's resorts in one tool, synced with Opera PMS.
projects.role: Designer and developer, from research to rollout

caseStudy.challenge: Sun Siyam Resorts' staff and resellers needed one place to check availability, make bookings and update prices across several resorts, kept in sync with the Opera PMS the resorts already use.
approach: Worked with the management team to map how bookings flow across properties and where the existing process broke down.
Designed the booking screens in Mantine UI and refined them in feedback sessions with the staff who would use them.
Built a synchronisation layer with Opera PMS that keeps both systems consistent and handles edge cases.
Used Meilisearch for fast availability search by dates, room type and price, on Next.js with Prisma.
Deployed in Docker on DigitalOcean, trained resort staff, and rolled out in phases across properties and sales channels.
caseStudy.outcome: One tool for availability, bookings and pricing across Sun Siyam's properties, rolled out after real-world testing.

projects.name: Maldives.com Website
projects.summary: Faster pages and simpler content editing for the country's flagship tourism site.

caseStudy.challenge: Maldives.com was an established tourism site, but pages were slow, the mobile experience was dated, and the marketing team struggled to update content.
approach: Audited the platform to find the bottlenecks: slow loads, outdated UI and limited content tools.
Replaced chatty REST calls with a GraphQL layer, cutting data transfer by 60%.
Rebuilt the mobile experience in Tailwind CSS, since mobile is over 60% of visits.
Added code splitting, lazy loading and image optimisation, cutting initial load time by 40%.
Moved content into Strapi with custom types and workflows, and set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker.
caseStudy.outcome: Conversion rose 35% and bounce rate fell 40%. Search rankings improved for key tourism terms, and content updates take the marketing team 75% less time.

projects.name: FSM Website
projects.summary: A rebrand website and CMS for Fuel Supply Maldives on React and .NET.

caseStudy.challenge: Fuel Supply Maldives, which supplies and distributes petroleum products across the country, was rebranding and needed a website to match.
approach: Built the front end in React and Tailwind CSS on a .NET Framework back end.
Hosted it on Azure with automatic scaling and load balancing, in Docker containers managed through Portainer.
Kept performance and security at the front, in line with FSM's focus on quality and safety.
caseStudy.outcome: Launched with the rebrand at fuel.mv.

projects.name: Travgo Maldives Platform
projects.summary: A travel agency site showcasing Maldives holiday styles, built on React and Firebase.

caseStudy.challenge: TravGo Maldives, a licensed travel agency in Malé, needed a stronger online presence, and its bookings were handled by hand.
approach: Researched the agency's audience and designed an interface that makes packages and booking options easy to find.
Built a booking system on Firebase Functions to replace the manual process.
Applied the agency's brand colours, logo and type throughout.
Built in SEO best practices from the start.
caseStudy.outcome: Customers book packages online, the team no longer processes bookings by hand, and organic search traffic grew.

projects.name: Ecommerce Platform
projects.summary: Ordering, payments and delivery tracking for local businesses on React and FastAPI.

caseStudy.challenge: Local businesses needed one platform to sell online and manage deliveries: browsing, ordering, payment and delivery tracking.
approach: Planned the core features: accounts, catalogue, cart, payments, order management and delivery tracking.
Designed the interface in Figma, then built it in React.
Built the API in FastAPI on PostgreSQL with JWT authentication, validation and error handling.
Tested with Jest and Pytest, and deployed to DigitalOcean with CI/CD.
caseStudy.outcome: A platform that covers the whole order flow, from browsing to delivery.

projects.name: Matcon Website
projects.summary: Company website for an engineering consultancy, on Next.js and Firebase.

caseStudy.challenge: MATCON, an engineering consultancy for civil, structural, transport and coastal projects, needed a website that explains its services and that its team can update.
approach: Ran discovery sessions to understand the business goals behind the brief.
Designed the interface and shared interactive prototypes early for feedback.
Built it in React and Next.js with content management and responsive layouts, tested across browsers and devices.
Deployed on Google Cloud with domain mapping and SSL, then trained the team to manage content.
caseStudy.outcome: Live at matcon.mv, and maintained after launch.

projects.name: Bespoke Maldives Website
projects.summary: A tourism site for Bespoke Maldives on Next.js, hosted on Vercel.

caseStudy.challenge: Bespoke Maldives works in the luxury travel market and needed a site that feels as exclusive as its properties while staying easy to use.
approach: Ran discovery sessions on their market position and goals, then designed wireframes and mockups in Figma.
Built it in Next.js and Tailwind CSS, with custom property showcases using subtle animation and high-resolution imagery.
Used Firebase for authentication and data, hosted on Vercel.
Set up analytics after launch and trained the team to use it.
caseStudy.outcome: A fast, responsive showcase for their properties, with analytics in place for future decisions.

projects.name: Matcon Mail Migration
projects.summary: Moved Matcon's mail and shared files to Google Workspace.

caseStudy.challenge: MATCON needed to move its email to a platform with better security, storage and collaboration, without disrupting daily work.
approach: Met stakeholders to pin down security, storage and collaboration needs, and chose Google Workspace.
Backed up all existing mail before changing anything.
Migrated in phases, starting with a small test group.
Tested mail, calendars and shared documents across devices, then trained the team.
caseStudy.outcome: Moved to Google Workspace with minimal disruption to the business.

projects.name: Maldives Consulting Group Networking
projects.summary: Rebuilt office networking for Maldives Consulting Group on UniFi, from WAN to Wi-Fi.

caseStudy.challenge: Maldives Consulting Group, a strategy-led communications consultancy, needed its office network rebuilt to fix existing problems, tighten security and leave room to grow.
approach: Met the leadership team on needs, security requirements and growth plans.
Documented the existing network and prepared a rollback plan before changing anything.
Installed a UniFi network in phases, from the core and WAN out to full-office Wi-Fi and NAS storage.
Tested each phase before moving on, then handed over documentation and trained the IT staff.
caseStudy.outcome: A secure, monitored network built to grow, with support after handover.
